name: autodj-frontend
description: Development tooling for the AutoDJ web UI: vitest unit tests, ESLint, knip and the Playwright audits.  The server serves src/autodj/static as-is; nothing here is needed to run AutoDJ.

scripts.lint: eslint --max-warnings 0 src/autodj/static tests/jsmodules tests/playwright vitest.config.js eslint.config.js
scripts.audit:ci: npm run audit:health && npm run audit:transitions && npm run audit:visual
